en: A black‑and‑white photograph of a calm canal or lagoon lined with tall, narrow trees, likely poplars. Several people stand or pole narrow wooden boats along the water; they wear light-colored clothing and broad-brimmed hats. The scene suggests traditional flat-bottomed boats moving through a watery landscape used for agriculture or transport. There is no visible printed title or caption on the front, only a small numeric code in the lower right corner.
